scientific_integrity: Direct radial Poisson-equation proof and exact Gaussian conditional law. A standalone exact-rational checker supplements the proof; source comparisons acknowledge their prior general methods.
scientific_limitations: Ideal isotropic planar Brownian diffusion with constant rotation and circular first exit, known diffusivity and geometry. Area-only noise floor is for the specified unbiased estimator, not an optimality lower bound for all area-only estimators. No measurement-noise or discrete-time extension. Independent novelty assessment remains open.
title: Exact stopped-area statistics and a non-self-averaging rotation estimate at circular escape
